difficulty_reason: Specializing the chapter's Proj-Spec dictionary (the diagram equation-proj-and-spec built from a graded algebra and its degree-zero Veronese), the lemma applies it to P proper over R with ample L: setting A = direct-sum Gamma(P, L^m), one has P = Proj(A), and the general diagram becomes the concrete one with the Z-graded total Spec U = Spec_P(direct-sum_{m in Z} L^m) mapping to L = Spec_P(direct-sum_{m >= 0} L^m) over P, retaining all previously established properties (the G_m-torsor structure of U over the complement, sigma quasi-affine, etc.). The retained proof is written: P = Proj(A) is Morphisms, lemma proper-ample-is-proj (the projective-embedding reconstruction from an ample line bundle); under that identification O_P(m) corresponds to L^m for all integers m via Properties, lemma ample-gcd-is-one (the period-one property of ample generators), which is exactly what the diagram instantiation requires. Retained author proof at lines 14514-14520.

dedup.scope: Concrete instantiation of the graded Spec-Proj diagram for ample line bundles on proper schemes.
